nodes.description: Owner address inherited from Ownable; grants privileged access via onlyOwner.
Master address that receives the entry payment in create and MASTER_FEE in buy.
Array of Heap structs storing all game state (ticket, timer, cap, bonus, players, owner).
Mapping ensuring each heap name is registered only once.
uint8 constant PAGE_SIZE = 25 used for pagination.
Fixed fee of 0.005 ether sent to master on every buy.
Minimum allowed ticket value (0.01 ether).
Maximum allowed ticket value (10 ether).
msg.sender, externally controlled caller address used for auth, ownership and payouts.
block.timestamp (now) used for heap timing and bonus logic.
tx.origin used in the msg.sender == tx.origin anti-contract check.
Ownable constructor that sets owner = msg.sender.
onlyOwner function that renounces ownership by setting owner to address(0).
onlyOwner function delegating to _transferOwnership.
Internal ownership transfer that writes the owner state variable.
onlyOwner function updating the master address.
Payable function creating a new Heap and forwarding msg.value to master.
Payable function joining a heap and distributing payouts via multiple external sends.
View returning the number of heaps.
View returning paginated heap data with countdown timers.
View returning whether a heap name is already registered.
View returning detailed data for a single heap.
SafeMath multiplication with overflow assertion.
SafeMath division.
SafeMath subtraction with underflow assertion.
SafeMath addition with overflow assertion.
master.transfer(msg.value) in create: external ether transfer to a stored address.
master.send(MASTER_FEE) in buy: external ether send to master inside a loop-heavy flow.
heaps[id].players[index].send(val) in a 10-iteration loop: sends ether to pseudo-randomly selected players.
heaps[id].cur_addr.send(bonus_val): sends accumulated bonus to current address.
heaps[id].owner.send(heaps[id].fee): sends the heap fee to the heap owner.
Constructor address parameter (unused in body).
New master address passed to set_master.
_newOwner passed to transferOwnership.
_newOwner used by _transferOwnership to write owner.
ticket value for the new heap; bounded by MIN/MAX_TICKET and multiplied by 20 for msg.value.
bytes32 name of the new heap; uniqueness enforced through used_names.
fee paid to the heap owner, bounded relative to ticket.
timer increment in seconds for the heap (30..10 days).
bonus fee accumulated per buy, bounded relative to ticket.
Heap index passed to buy; bounds-checked against heaps.length.
Page number used to compute the pagination start index.
Heap index passed to get_heap.
Name queried in is_name_used.
keccak256 hash combined from blockhash, msg.sender and heaps.length used for pseudo-random index.
Modulo-derived index into heaps[id].players receiving the payout.
Per-player payout computed from ticket minus fee, MASTER_FEE and bonus_fee.
Result of external send calls, returned bool ignored.
Captured bonus to pay to cur_addr when the timer has expired.
Loop counter (0..9) for the payout loop.
In-memory Heap struct pushed into heaps.
Empty players array initialising the new heap.
Pagination start index computed as page * PAGE_SIZE.
Remaining countdown timer for a heap in get_heap.
Remaining countdown timer per entry in get_heaps.

edges.reason: Ownable constructor sets owner from msg.sender, granting privileged control to the caller.
msg.sender flows into the Ownable constructor that initialises the owner.
onlyOwner modifier on renounceOwnership compares msg.sender with owner.
msg.sender is checked against owner by the onlyOwner modifier.
renounceOwnership writes owner = address(0).
onlyOwner gate on transferOwnership.
msg.sender checked against owner in transferOwnership.
transferOwnership delegates to internal _transferOwnership.
_transferOwnership reads/writes the privileged owner state.
_transferOwnership writes owner = _newOwner and emits OwnershipTransferred.
_newOwner parameter flows into transferOwnership.
_newOwner is forwarded into _transferOwnership.
Internal _newOwner parameter feeds the ownership write.
_newOwner becomes the new privileged owner.
onlyOwner gate on set_master.
msg.sender checked against owner in set_master.
set_master updates the master address controlling fund flow.
addr parameter flows into set_master.
addr parameter is written into the master state variable.
require(msg.sender == tx.origin) makes create depend on tx.origin.
msg.sender is required, stored as heap owner and checked against master/owner.
now is stored into heap.time and used to compute heap.timer, making game timing timestamp dependent.
create pushes a new Heap into heaps.
create sets used_names[name] = true.
create reads master for the guard checks and for msg.value transfer.
ticket parameter drives heap creation and the required msg.value.
name parameter is stored in the heap and used_names.
fee parameter is stored in the heap.
timer_inc parameter sets the heap timer increment.
bonus_fee parameter sets the heap bonus fee.
create performs master.transfer(msg.value), an external value transfer.
master address is the recipient of the transferred value.
External transfer to master could re-enter create (limited 2300 gas).
msg.sender is added to players and is a possible payout recipient in buy.
require(msg.sender == tx.origin) makes buy depend on tx.origin.
now and blockhash(block.number-...) drive the timer and pseudo-random payouts.
buy reads heaps[id] fields (ticket, fee, timer, bonus, players, cur_addr).
buy mutates heaps[id] (players, cur_addr, timer, bonus, cap).
id parameter indexes the heaps array in buy.
buy performs master.send(MASTER_FEE), an external call before all state settles.
buy performs a loop of players[index].send(val) external value transfers.
buy performs cur_addr.send(bonus_val) external value transfer.
buy performs owner.send(fee) external value transfer.
master address receives MASTER_FEE.
players array from heaps supplies send recipients.
cur_addr field from heaps is the bonus recipient.
owner state is a possible heap fee recipient and sender check.
External send to master can re-enter buy before completion.
External send to a player can re-enter buy repeatedly.
External send to cur_addr can re-enter buy.
External send to heap owner can re-enter buy.
get_len reads heaps.length.
PAGE_SIZE determines the returned array lengths in get_heaps.
get_heaps reads heap fields for the requested page.
now is compared to heap timers to compute countdowns.
page parameter drives the pagination logic.
is_name_used reads used_names.
name parameter is looked up in used_names.
get_heap reads a single heap record.
now is compared to heaps[id].timer to compute remaining time.
id parameter indexes the heap returned by get_heap.
create uses SafeMath.mul (ticket.mul(20)) for arithmetic guards.
buy uses SafeMath.sub to compute the per-player payout value.
buy uses SafeMath.add to update the heap cap.
get_heap uses SafeMath.sub to compute the payout preview.
get_heaps uses SafeMath.mul to compute the page start index.

normalization_plan.reason: Constructor parameter is only meaningful as input to the Ownable constructor node.
Address parameter exists solely to feed the set_master write.
_newOwner is the direct input to transferOwnership.
Internal _newOwner feeds the owner write in _transferOwnership.
Ticket value is only used inside create's bounds checks and heap initialisation.
Name parameter is consumed only by create to set used_names and heap data.
Fee parameter only participates in create's ratio checks and heap fields.
timer_inc is used only within create to size the heap timer.
bonus_fee is only relevant to create's bounds checks and heap setup.
Heap id parameter is only meaningful inside the buy flow.
Page parameter only drives get_heaps pagination arithmetic.
Heap id parameter only indexes get_heap's array access.
Name parameter is only used to query used_names in is_name_used.
Temporary pseudo-random hash used only inside buy to derive the payout index.
Local index exists only to select a player in buy's payout loop.
Locally computed payout amount used only inside buy's send loop.
Return value of external sends, used only within buy and never checked.
Captured bonus is only used to feed the cur_addr send in buy.
Loop counter local to buy's ten-iteration payout loop.
In-memory Heap struct exists solely to be pushed inside create.
Empty players array is only used to initialise the new heap in create.
Pagination start index is local to get_heaps' loop setup.
Countdown timer is only computed for the get_heap return payload.
Per-entry countdown timer is local to the get_heaps loop.
